reason: EMPHASIS-HF: NYHA II, EF <=35%, registry minimum age 55. Served HR 0.76 (0.62-0.93) is printed in the abstract and equals the registry's cut-off analysis HR 0.761 (0.622-0.932), 171 vs 213. The complete-DB counts (205 vs 253) carry no HR, so the extractor's 'longer follow-up' objection has no alternative number and is rejected.
